decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (359WELL001-5, proposed block plan, location plan, received on 07/05/2014 and 359WELL001-4 Rev 2 received on 08/05/2014 and amended 359WELL001-1, 359WELL001-2, 359WELL001-3REV1, 359WELL001-4REV1 received on 02/09/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of first floor side extension and conversion of flat roof to pitch
